Data residency & audit: Require EU residency for EMEA customer data and 2yr audit log retention; KMS integration with customer-managed keys mandatory for private deployment.
Reserved GPU planning: Baseline reservation 16 GPUs (A100 equiv) for predictable throughput; burst up to 32 GPUs with pre-negotiated burst credits and firm allocation for earnings events.
Failover & fallback: Must support automatic region failover with consistent model variants; Redwood to specify RTO/RPO targets in contract.
Pricing & termination: HarborView requests capped rate increases and a clause for early termination on repeated SLA breaches.
